provenance.title: Wet zones
provenance.covers: Which rooms are wet zones where ordinary sockets are not allowed. Written from general knowledge in our own words, not copied from the sources.

sources.name: Approved Document P: Electrical safety, dwellings (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. The whole room counts as a wet zone. No ordinary sockets. A professional decides about a shaver socket.
